summary_for_children: Az-Zalzalah says that whoever does even an atom's weight of good will see it, and whoever does an atom's weight of bad will see it.
environment_concept: A morning garden where tiny specks of dust drift in shafts of sunlight and rows of very small seedlings grow. They show how small an atom's weight is (99:7-8): even the smallest good is seen. The earthquake of 99:1 and the Day are not pictured. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: Garden rows of seedlings, a gap in the trees where sunbeams fall.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A quiet hill village on an ordinary afternoon with a well, washing on a line and children’s play in the lane

primary_mechanic.text: Meet five tiny moments in the lanes (a coin in the dust, a thirsty cat, a queue at the well, washing blown down, a child’s sand fort); each offers a tiny good and a tiny wrong; the wrong is refused with 99:8 (even an atom’s weight); the good settles as a speck of golden light (99:7).

secondary_activities: when the earth is shaken (99:1-3, read; never shown)
the earth tells its news (99:4-6, read)
unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading in the lane, the five small moments, then a reading at the top of the village
environment_behaviour: each met moment leaves a small golden mote on the ground
unique_world.learning_objective: Know that even an atom’s weight of good or evil will be seen (99:7-8)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: Even the Smallest Deed Matters
story_library.children_narration: Surah Az-Zalzalah describes the earth shaking on the Day of Judgment. It teaches that even the smallest good deed matters, and even the smallest wrong action is not forgotten. We should never think that a small act of kindness is unimportant.

world_idea.title: The World of Little Actions
world_idea.description: An educational town where small actions create visible positive consequences. The earthquake and judgment passages are presented through narration without claiming to reproduce them.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
story_library.rule_conflicts_resolved: The earthquake of the Last Day is not simulated.
